name.en: Fio Puro Stone Neutral Tailored Wool Coat with Notched Lapels, a Knee Length and a Clean Front
name.pt-BR: Casaco alfaiataria Fio Puro pedra, neutro, de lã, com lapela, comprimento no joelho e frente limpa

description.en: A stone wool coat in a neutral tone, tailored through the shoulder, with notched lapels and a knee length. It goes over black without competing.
description.pt-BR: Casaco de lã pedra, tom neutro, ombro alfaiatado, lapela e comprimento no joelho. Entra sobre preto sem disputar.
